meta.title: Atoll Notices
meta.description: Mirrors DeepSeek Harness task states - failed, waiting for you, and finished - in the Atoll Dynamic Island on macOS.

settings.title: Atoll Notices
settings.description: Choose which task states reach the Dynamic Island and whether a sound plays for each one.
settings.failedHint: A red notice while a turn ends with an error.
settings.attentionHint: A yellow notice while an approval or a question needs an answer.
settings.doneHint: A green notice when a turn finishes without an error.
settings.soundHint: Uses a macOS system alert sound; at most one every few seconds.
settings.portHint: Atoll listens on this local port; change it only if Atoll was reconfigured.
settings.unavailable: The Atoll Notices settings are not served by this deployment.
